TRELIze LLC acts as a controller with respect to subscriber personal data, and processes two categories of data:
1. Public Records Data (not "personal data" under § 509.001)
TRELIze collects and processes real property information sourced entirely from Texas public records, including: Harris County Clerk filings (probate case records, foreclosure notices, lien instruments, trustee sale notices, lis pendens filings); and Harris County Appraisal District (HCAD) records (property addresses, appraised values, owner names, owner mailing addresses, property classifications, exemption status, building characteristics). This data constitutes publicly available information as defined under § 509.001 and is therefore not "personal data" subject to the TDPSA. TRELIze does not transfer this category of data to third parties.
2. Subscriber Personal Data (subject to § 509 definitions)
TRELIze collects and processes personal data from individuals who create an account or purchase a subscription, including: name, email address, phone number, and payment information. TRELIze is the controller of this data. TRELIze engages the following processors who process subscriber personal data solely on TRELIze's behalf and at TRELIze's direction: Postmark (transactional email delivery — receives subscriber email addresses); Twilio (SMS delivery — receives subscriber phone numbers); Stripe (payment processing — receives subscriber payment card data; TRELIze does not store card numbers). TRELIze does not sell subscriber personal data, does not process it for targeted advertising, and does not use it for profiling that produces legal or similarly significant effects.

TRELIze LLC operates a real estate lead intelligence platform that monitors Harris County, Texas public records on behalf of licensed real estate investors and professionals. The platform aggregates publicly available court and property records — probate filings, foreclosure notices, lien instruments, and trustee sale notices — and presents them in a structured format to assist subscribers in identifying motivated sellers.
The personal data TRELIze processes from subscribers (name, email, phone, payment information) is used solely to operate the subscription service and deliver the product. TRELIze does not sell, rent, or share subscriber personal data with third parties for their independent use. Service providers who receive subscriber data (Postmark, Twilio, Stripe) are contractually limited to processing that data on TRELIze's behalf.
The underlying property and public records data processed by TRELIze is sourced exclusively from Texas government agencies — the Harris County District Clerk, Harris County Clerk, and Harris County Appraisal District — and constitutes publicly available information under Texas law. TRELIze does not acquire personal data from data brokers, data aggregators, or commercial data providers.

To provide context on Resonate's data collection practices, it may be helpful to understand our offering at a high level.
Resonate maintains approximately 230 million pseudonymized consumer profiles used for audience insight development and media targeting. These profiles are built from online surveys that collect responses on topics such as personal values, motivations, brand affinity, and media interests. Respondents opt in at both the survey panel provider level and again at the start of the Resonate-specific survey (double opt-in).
Survey responses are then used as training data to model and infer attributes across the broader US population. For example, if 5,000 survey respondents identify as customers of a particular brand, Resonate models the characteristics of that group and projects those attributes to statistically similar consumers nationwide. The resulting profiles are inferred, not directly collected at the individual level.
Resonate's customers use our platform to develop audience insights - for example, understanding the brand preferences or media habits of a given consumer segment - and to activate those audiences through digital media campaigns. Resonate profiles are linked only to pseudonymous identifiers and are not associated with directly identifying information such as name or address within our systems.

Mobile Advertising ID
The Mobile Advertising ID, also referred to as a MAID, is a string of digits associated with a mobile device assigned by operating systems like Android and Apple IOS. 
IDFV
The ID for Vendors (IDFV) is a code assigned to all apps by one developer and is shared across all apps by that developer on your Apple IOS device.
Cookie ID 
This is a unique identifier made up of a string of characters that websites and servers associate with the browser on which the cookie is stored. 
Cross-Device ID
This ID is a user ID created by using statistical, deterministic and probabilistic algorithms in an attempt to link devices and identifiers belonging to the same user.

Location related data

Inferred data
We might infer some data about you based on your demographics (e.g., age or gender), browsing behaviour or your location data. column16: In its capacity as a data broker, SheerID does not sell or share any personally identifiable information ("PII") that SheerID collects directly from consumers.  Instead, SheerID only resells lists that are compiled by third parties.  Specifically, SheerID's customers (all of which are merchants) provide SheerID with criteria that those customers would like to use to enhance their ability to target their direct marketing campaign (such as: current students, retired military personnel, etc.).  SheerID identifies third parties who can provide lists that meet the customers' criteria, purchases those lists, and then resells those lists to its customers.  Importantly, SheerID prohibits its employees from accessing the lists themselves; SheerID simply receives the files (often in .zip format) from its data sources and then uploads those files to its customers' accounts.  Furthermore, SheerID's contracts with its data sources require that those entities comply with all applicable data privacy laws while collecting, processing, and selling PII.
